blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: High-granularity topic modelling extracts hundreds of niche topics from a corpus, yet this regime is rarely studied and is more commonly framed as a failure mode: "over-clustering," in which coherent themes fragment into redundant subtopics. We argue that this framing conflates genuine redundancy with topics that are semantically similar but meaningfully distinct, and that the central challenge in high-granularity modelling is separating the two. Recent post-hoc refinement methods address topic redundancy through either embedding-based similarity thresholding or LLM-guided merging. We show that neither suffices in high-granularity settings and propose embedding-gated iterative merge (EGIM), a hybrid approach that iteratively generates context-rich topic representations, uses embedding similarity to propose candidate merges across the topic space, then applies LLM judgement to accept only genuinely redundant pairs while preserving niche distinctions. Across two patent corpora and one legal corpus, LLM judgement rejects 83% of embedding-identified candidates as non-redundant. EGIM improves discriminability on merged topics by 25-55% over a prior iterative LLM baseline while better preserving the original topic distribution.
blocks.zh: 高引力主题建模从一个文体中提取了数百个特殊主题,然而这种制度很少被研究,更常见地被设定为一个失败模式:"超群化",其中连贯的主题分裂成多余的子主题. 我们主张,这种框架将真正的冗余性与具有相似性但有意义的不同性的主题混为一谈,而高角度建模的核心挑战是将两者分开。 近期的改进后方法通过嵌入式类似阈值或LLM制导的合并来解决专题冗余问题。 我们显示,在高角性环境中,两者都不够,建议嵌入式迭代合并(EGIM),这是一种混合方法,迭代生成内容丰富的专题表述,采用嵌入式相似性,提议在整个专题空间进行候选合并,然后运用LLM判断,只接受真正冗余的对子,同时保留特殊性区别。 在两个专利公司和一个法律实体中,LLM判决拒绝83%的嵌入物被确定为非多余候选人。 EGIM比之前的迭代LLM基线提高了25-55%对合并主题的区别性,同时更好地保留了原来的主题分布.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Standard topic model benchmarks operate at moderate granularity, typically between 20 and 100 topics. Yet a range of downstream text-mining tasks, such as competitive intelligence in patent informatics Tang et al. (2012) and area-of-law mapping in legal corpora Wendel et al. (2022) , can benefit from niche topic extraction via high-granularity topic model regimes. When models are pushed to higher topic counts, the result is commonly framed as "over-clustering": outputs that are overly complex and yield many redundant or highly similar topics, reducing topic interpretability and practical usefulness Greene et al. (2014) ; Meaney et al. (2023) ; Gan and Qi (2021) . We argue that this framing conflates genuinely redundant topics with semantically similar but distinct ones, and that the core challenge in high-granularity topic modelling is developing refinement methods that can distinguish the two.
blocks.zh: 标准专题模型基准在中度颗粒度下运作,一般在20至100个专题之间. 然而,一系列下游的文本开采任务,如专利信息学中的竞争情报Tang等人(2012年)和法律公司的法律区域测绘 Wendel等人(2022年),可通过高角性专题示范制度从特有专题提取中受益。 当模型被推向更高的主题计数时,结果通常被设定为"超集群":产出过于复杂并产生许多冗余或高度相近的主题,降低了主题的解释性和实用性. Greene等 (2014年); Meaney等 (2023年); Gan和Qi (2021年). 我们认为,这种框架将真正多余的专题与类似但又截然不同的专题混为一谈,而高广度专题建模的核心挑战是制定能够区分两者的完善方法。

blocks.en: Topic redundancy is a well-documented issue in topic modelling Greene et al. (2014) ; O’Callaghan et al. (2015) , including with LLM-generated topic descriptors Mu et al. (2024) ; Singh et al. (2025) . Prior work on post-hoc reduction of topic redundancy falls into two broad categories: similarity-threshold methods, which merge topics based on vector distances Grootendorst (2022) , and LLM-guided methods, which prompt language models to identify and consolidate redundant topics Janssens et al. (2025) ; Pham et al. (2024) . We show that neither is adequate in high-granularity regimes: threshold methods cannot distinguish genuinely redundant pairs from semantically similar ones, and LLM-guided methods are susceptible to semantic snowballing , in which progressively broader merged labels attract further merges and collapse the topic distribution.
blocks.zh: 专题冗余是专题建模中一个有充分记载的问题 Greene等人(2014年);O Callaghan等人(2015年),包括LLM生成的专题描述词Mu等人(2024年);Singh等人(2025年)。 先前关于事后减少重复专题的工作分为两大类:相似-阈值方法,将基于矢量距离(Grootendorst (2022年)的专题合并;LLM-指针方法,促使语言模型确定并合并冗余专题Jansens等 (2025年);Pham等 (2024年). 我们显示,在高角度制度中两者都不合适:阈值方法无法将真正冗余的对子和类似对子区分开来,而LLM制导方法容易被语义上雪球所吸引,其中逐渐扩大的合并标签会吸引进一步合并并瓦解专题分布.

blocks.en: We propose embedding-gated iterative merge (EGIM) , a hybrid post-hoc refinement method that uses embedding similarity to select candidate topic pairs, then reduces each decision to a binary merge-or-keep judgment by a single LLM call. Because each call concerns one pair, the prompt can include representative documents from both topics, grounding the decision in corpus evidence rather than label semantics alone. Candidate pairs are selected via k-means sampling across the topic-embedding space rather than by greedy similarity sampling; we show in an ablation that this coverage-based strategy identifies more true duplicates. Because EGIM operates as a merge-keep loop, termination is conditioned on convergence (a fixed number of consecutive iterations without a merge) rather than a predefined target topic count. In practice, merge occurrences decrease steadily across iterations and the method converges naturally.
blocks.zh: 我们提议嵌入式迭接合并(EGIM),是一种混合后热量完善方法,它使用嵌入式相似性来选择候选主题对,然后通过一个LLM调用将每个决定简化为二进制合并或保持判断. 由于每次通话都涉及一对,提示可以包括两个专题的具有代表性的文件,从而证明裁决是物证而非仅标注语义。 候选配对是通过在主题-嵌入空间的K-手段取样来选择的,而不是通过贪婪的相似性取样来选择的;我们用一种暗示方式表明,这种基于覆盖的战略确定了更真实的重复。 因为EGIM是作为合并-保持循环运行的,所以终止是以趋同(没有合并的固定连续迭接次数)而不是预先定义的目标主题计数为条件的. 在实践中,合并现象在各种迭代中稳步减少,方法自然趋同。

blocks.en: To evaluate post-hoc refinement in high-granularity regimes, we introduce two diagnostics: topic dispersion , which measures distributional balance and penalises mega-topics more heavily than niche ones, and topic discriminability , which measures how well a topic’s representation aligns with its assigned documents relative to non-assigned documents. Across two patent corpora and a legal corpus, we find that 83% of high-similarity topic pairs are rejected as non-redundant by the LLM. EGIM improves topic discriminability by 25–55% over an iterative LLM baseline while preserving over 94% of original topic dispersion across all three corpora, compared to 34–88% for the baseline.
blocks.zh: 为了评价高强度制度中的事后完善情况,我们提出两个诊断:专题分散,衡量分配平衡和惩罚的特大专题比特殊专题更重;专题歧视,衡量专题的表述与所指定文件相对于未指定文件的配合程度。 我们发现83%的高同位素主题对子 被LLM拒绝为非多余 EGIM将话题的区别性比LLM的迭接基线提高了25-55%,同时保留了所有三个公司94%以上的原话题分散度,而基线为34-88 %.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Most topic modeling research evaluates at low to moderate granularity, with topic counts optimized for automated metrics or drawn from standardized ranges on benchmark corpora. Work explicitly targeting high-granularity regimes is typically driven by downstream requirements. Boutaleb et al. (2024) propose BERTrend, a framework for detecting weak thematic signals and emerging trends, built on BERTopic with hyperparameters selected for the explicit purpose of producing fine-grained topics. The FIDELITY framework ( Singh et al., 2025 ) identifies a research gap in topic modeling approaches for high-granularity output and proposes clustering extracted keyphrases to produce fine-grained phrasal topics. Singh et al. (2025) also raise concerns about their post-hoc redundancy method based on cosine similarity, noting it may oversimplify distinctions between closely related topics, and suggest LLM-based merging as a potential remedy.
blocks.zh: 大多数专题建模研究以中低颗粒度评价,专题计数优化为自动化度量衡,或取自基准单位的标准化范围. 明确针对高灵活性制度的工作通常由下游要求所驱动。 Boutaleb等人(2024年)提议BERTREND是探测弱主题信号和新趋势的框架,其基础是BERTOPIC,为产生精细主题而选择的超参数。 FIDELITY框架(Singh等,2025年)确定了高角度输出专题建模方法方面的研究空白,并提议将提取出的关键词组合起来,以产生精细的词组主题. Singh等人(2025年)也对其基于余弦相近性的热后冗余方法表示关切,指出这种方法可能过分地简化了对密切相关专题的区分,并建议以LLM为基础的合并作为一种潜在的补救办法。

blocks.en: Existing approaches to post-hoc topic redundancy reduction fall into two broad categories.
blocks.zh: 减少专题重复的现有办法分为两大类。

blocks.en: Threshold-based strategies consolidate topics by the similarity of their vector representations. BERTopic ( Grootendorst, 2022 ) implements topic reduction via agglomerative clustering over class-based TF-IDF representations. Blair et al. (2020) apply a comparable strategy to aggregated LDA ensembles, merging topics that exceed predefined cosine similarity and Jensen–Shannon divergence thresholds. These methods are efficient but cannot judge whether two similar topics are genuinely redundant or capture meaningful distinctions at fine granularity.
blocks.zh: 以阈值为基础的战略通过它们的矢量表示的相似性来整合话题. BERTOPIC(Grootendorst, 2022年)通过基于分级的TF-IDF表达方式的群集执行对话题的减少. Blair等人(2020年)对LDA组合应用了可比较的战略,将超过预定义的同位素相似度和Jensen–Shannon相差阈值的专题合并. 这些方法是有效的,但不能判断两个相类似的专题是否真正多余,也不能在细颗粒性上抓住有意义的区别。

blocks.en: LLM-facilitated methods replace or supplement similarity thresholds with language model judgment. PromptTopic ( Wang et al., 2023 ) includes a topic-collapse stage that uses an LLM to merge overlapping topics based solely on topic names until a target topic count is obtained. TopicGPT ( Pham et al., 2024 ) similarly details a single-step hybrid clean-up stage in which they first identify topic labels above a set threshold (>0.5 cosine similarity) before passing topic lists to an LLM to make merge decisions. Most similar to our work is that of Janssens et al. (2025) , who specifically investigates reduction of overlapping topics from base model outputs (BERTopic). Janssens et al. (2025) iteratively utilises an LLM to perform both topic candidate selection and merged topic representation from the current topic representation list, until a desired topic count is reached.
blocks.zh: 通过语言模型判断取代或补充类似阈值的方法。 PlainTopic (Wang等, 2023) 包括一个主题-collapse阶段,它使用LLM将完全基于主题名称的重叠主题合并,直到获得目标主题计数. 专题GPT (Pham等人,2024年)类似地详细介绍了单步混合清理阶段,在将专题列表传递给LLM以做出合并决定之前,他们首先识别出高于设定阈值(>0.5同位素相似性)的专题标签. 与我们的工作最相类似的是Janssens等人(2025年),他专门调查了从基准模型产出(BERTOPIC)中减少重叠议题的情况. Janssens等人(2025年)反复利用LLM进行专题候选选择,并从当前专题代表名单中合并专题代表,直至达到理想的专题数。

blocks.en: Our work extends this line of research by decoupling candidate selection from merge judgment. Prior LLM-facilitated methods present the model with full or partial topic lists, requiring it to simultaneously identify merge candidates and execute merges. This scales poorly to high-granularity settings, where hundreds of thematically narrow topics exhaust the context window and leave little room for the document-level evidence needed to distinguish genuine redundancy from meaningful specificity. Our method instead uses semantic embeddings for thematically-aware candidate selection, reducing each merge decision to a single topic pair presented alongside representative documents for binary LLM judgment. The topic landscape is then updated and the process repeats, allowing natural convergence rather than reduction to a predefined count. Empirically, we find that the LLM rejects the majority of embedding-selected candidates, particularly in later iterations, demonstrating that similarity-threshold selection alone systematically conflates semantic proximity with genuine redundancy at high granularity.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Embedding-Gated Iterative Merge
blocks.zh: 3.1 嵌入式迭代合并

blocks.en:
Given an initial high-granularity topic model with document–topic assignments and a keyword-based topic representation, we first generate contextually rich topic representations by prompting an LLM with each topic’s keywords and representative documents to produce a descriptive label and summary. The refinement algorithm then operates over these LLM-generated representations, iteratively removing redundant topics. The algorithm does not require specifying a target topic count; it
terminates when no merge occurs for N N consecutive rounds (patience
parameter) or when an LLM call budget is reached. The output is an updated topic set with revised representations and merged assignments.

blocks.en: The prompts encode a conservative granularity policy that favours Keep when topics address distinct aspects of a shared domain, and Merge only when they describe the same underlying concept; in practice, this policy can be adjusted to reflect application needs. We cache declined pairs ( ℰ \mathcal{E} ) to avoid repeated judgement calls; since merges produce a new topic, cached entries involving the constituent topics naturally become stale and the new topic is evaluated afresh against its neighbours. Full prompt templates and implementation details are provided in Appendix A and Appendix B .

blocks.en: 3.3 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 3.3 实验设计

blocks.en: We split our evaluation into two stages. Stage A performs a multi-factor calibration sweep to characterize how modeling choices interact in high-granularity topic modeling pipelines. In Stage B, we apply the insights from Stage A to produce high-granularity topic models on our datasets, then isolate the effect of our post-hoc refinement.
blocks.zh: 我们把评估分为两个阶段。 阶段 A进行多因子校正扫描,以描述模型选择如何在高角度主题建模管道中相互作用. 在B阶段,我们将A阶段的见解应用到我们的数据集上,产生出高角性主题模型,然后隔离出我们完成后改进的效果.

blocks.en: We adopt BERTopic ( Grootendorst, 2022 ) as our base topic model to produce initial document–topic assignments and topic representations. BERTopic is representative of the embedding-cluster framework popular in modern topic modeling: documents or document chunks are encoded with a sentence-transformer model, embeddings reduced via UMAP McInnes et al. (2020) , clustered with HDBSCAN Campello et al. (2015) , and each cluster represented via class-based term frequency–inverse document frequency (c-TF-IDF) keyword extraction.
blocks.zh: 我们采用BERTOPIC(GROOTENDORST, 2022年)作为我们编写初步文件的基本主题模型, BERTOPIC代表了现代主题模型中流行的嵌入-集群框架:文档或文档块被用句子转换模型编码,通过UMAP McInnes等人(2020年)的嵌入减少,由HDBSCAN Campello等人(2015年)组合而成,每个集群通过类词频率代表-反向文档频率(c-TF-IDF)关键词提取.

blocks.en: Stage A investigates how chunk size and preprocessing interact with granularity in the base BERTopic model. We perform a factorial sweep over corpus × \times preprocessing × \times chunk size × \times K K : three corpora, six preprocessing variants, three chunk sizes { 2 , 5 , 10 } \{2,5,10\} sentences, and five target granularities K ∈ { 20 , 40 , 80 , 160 , 320 } K\in\{20,40,80,160,320\} , yielding 270 270 total configurations. As BERTopic’s component models (UMAP and HDBSCAN) are sensitive to the underlying data distribution and desired cluster granularity, we additionally optimize each configuration for 50 trials using Optuna ( Akiba et al., 2019 ) , with a composite objective balancing topic quality and cluster validity (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: Stage B isolates the effect of refinement by fixing chunk size to 2 sentences and target granularity to K = 320 K{=}320 , guided by Stage A findings (Section 4.3 ), while retaining all six preprocessing variants across all three corpora to give 18 base topic models. Each refinement method is applied to every base model and compared using dispersion and discriminability as primary diagnostics, targeting the two main failure modes of high-granularity refinement: granularity loss via distribution collapse and non-discriminative topic labels.
blocks.zh: B阶段以A阶段调查结果(第4.3节)为指导,通过将块大小固定为2个句子,将目标颗粒度固定为K = 320 K{=}320来隔离精细化的效果,同时保留所有3个公司的所有6个预处理变体,给出18个基本专题模型. 每种改进方法都应用于每个基模型,并比较使用分散和可区分性作为初级诊断,针对高角性改进的两种主要故障模式:颗粒性通过分配崩溃而丢失和无差别主题标签.

standard human evaluation tasks: (i) coherence rating , where

conventional automated metrics, and that LLM word-intrusion accuracy
approaches that of humans. We use
GPT-4o OpenAI et al. (2024) with domain-adapted prompts
(Appendix A ).

blocks.en:
We compare EGIM against the iterative LLM-based topic reduction method
of Janssens et al. (2025) (hereafter LLM-Iter ). At each iteration, LLM-Iter presents the current topic representations to the LLM and prompts it to identify and merge the two most similar topics, repeating until a target count is reached. We use the same topic representation form as EGIM (LLM-generated label+summary) so that differences reflect the method structure rather than the topic representation type. Two key differences between methods remain: (i) EGIM uses embedding similarity to identify candidate pairs rather than relying on the LLM for candidate selection; and (ii) EGIM permits the LLM to decline a merge, whereas LLM-Iter merges unconditionally the candidates identified.

我们比较EGIM与基于LLM的迭代主题还原法

repeated evaluation of the same neighbourhood rather than

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce EGIM, a methodology that can be applied to base topic
models for topic redundancy removal in high-granularity regimes.
Through a series of design decisions we resolve limitations of prior
post-hoc refinement strategies that result in incorrect merging and
distribution collapse, both leading to reduction in desired granularity.
To measure the common failure modes of high-granularity modelling we
proposed (i) topic dispersion, a distribution metric that penalises
topic collapse, and (ii) topic discriminability, a metric for measuring
the distinctiveness of a topic label within a topic model, key for
useful high-granularity topic modelling.

Across two patent corpora and a legal corpus, we found that 83% of
high-similarity candidate pairs were rejected as non-redundant by LLM
judgment, confirming that semantic similarity alone cannot distinguish
true duplicates from distinct-but-related topics. EGIM distributed
merges across 3.1 × 3.1{\times} more distinct targets than the iterative

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our study utilised a single embedding model for core topic modelling
and topic representation sampling, and a single LLM for both the
methodology and evaluation. Whilst we chose a modern instruction-tuned
embedding model for our experiments, it would be interesting to
investigate how different model sizes and potential domain fine-tuning
alter results. In particular, our candidate selection uses
Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B; different embedding models may shift the similarity
distributions for the merge/keep decisions, and
domain-tuned embedding models may better
differentiate genuinely duplicate pairs from related-but-distinct
ones, potentially decreasing the AUC overlap of merge and keep
decisions when applied to specific corpora. The coverage-based sampling
ablation was also conducted on a single configuration rather than
across all 18, limiting the strength of that finding. Early testing
found that local LLM models struggled with producing high-quality
topic representations and topic evaluation, however we foresee this
limitation dissolving with the current upward performance trend of
smaller LLMs.

Stage A hinted at an interesting result in conventional coherence
metric reliability at high granularity, with UMass maintaining
consistent correlation with our LLM human-task proxies. Whilst this
may be a result of the structure of the UMass metric (no sliding
windows, thus potentially handling rare vocabulary better), we did not
feel confident enough with our amount of data to make definitive
claims. In addition, whilst topic discriminability and topic dispersion
worked well to measure our targeted failure modes, we saw little
change in model-wide metrics after post-hoc refinement under either
method. We attribute this to the relatively low proportion of topics
that get altered in our high-granularity regime, but investigating how
these metrics change with more aggressive reduction (lowering the
similarity threshold, increasing the LLM call budget, or altering the
merge prompt to favour merge decisions more readily) would be an
interesting direction.

blocks.en:
Both our embedding model and LLM are capable of multilingual
processing, however all three corpora were constrained to English. It
would be a useful investigation to see how a multilingual dataset
alters the methodology’s decisions in how topics are merged and
represented. In addition, we chose to use three specialised corpora
over traditional topic model benchmark corpora. This decision was made
because our corpora represent real-world targets for high-granularity
regimes that could provide valuable input to downstream use cases;
however, a trade-off in cross-work comparison was made, and future
investigation into post-hoc refinement for high-granularity regimes
should consider including standard benchmarks.

blocks.en:
Our methodology and LLM-based evaluation both rely on OpenAI
closed-source models, raising reproducibility concerns: model
versioning means our exact results may not be replicable if the
underlying model is updated or deprecated, and API costs present a
barrier to replication. Whilst we found early on that local models
gave inferior results for both topic representation and merge
judgment, a systematic comparison of local versus closed-source
performance would strengthen reproducibility and help establish the
minimum model capability required for effective merge decisions.

Standard NLTK English stopwords, in addition to corpus-specific
stopwords (tokens appearing in ≥ 70 % {\geq}\,70\% of documents) are
removed at the token level. This tests whether token-level
pre-embedding cleaning can improve subsequent text clustering and
thus topic modelling output.

Domain-specific regex patterns flag entire sentences as noise. For
patents, six pattern groups target: section headings (“field of the
invention”, “background of the disclosure”), filing metadata
(“claims the benefit of”, “continuation of”, “PCT application”),
figure and table references (“Fig. 3”, “as illustrated in”),
bare specifications without context (“operating temperature”,
“frequency … GHz”), generic computing scaffolding (“a
processor”, “computer-readable medium”), and claim-style fragments
(“the method comprises”, “the apparatus of”). For legal
documents, patterns target procedural text (“appeal dismissed”,
“hearing date”), case citation references (“see … v.”, “in
re”), and structural headings. Sentences shorter than 20 characters
or 4 tokens are also removed.

candidate pairs.
